recommendations.title: Maintain a clear and well-lit entrance
actions: Keep the entrance unobstructed and adequately lit.
Avoid heavy storage immediately beside the entrance.
limitations: Belief-based Vastu guidance; not a structural assessment.

recommendations.title: Review entrance location during planning
actions: Evaluate whether the entrance can move toward a preferred zone.
Coordinate changes with circulation and safety requirements.
limitations: Entrance relocation requires architect and engineer review.

recommendations.title: Prefer South-East kitchen placement
actions: Prefer South-East where feasible.
Consider North-West as a secondary option.
limitations: Fire safety, ventilation and services take precedence.

recommendations.title: Optimise the existing kitchen internally
actions: Review stove, sink and working-direction placement.
Avoid unsafe service relocation.
limitations: Internal optimisation does not change room location.

recommendations.title: Prioritise South-West for the master bedroom
actions: Allocate the South-West bedroom as the master bedroom where feasible.
limitations: Accessibility, privacy and family needs remain important.

recommendations.title: Review toilet placement
actions: Avoid North-East and central zones where feasible.
Coordinate changes with plumbing and waterproofing.
limitations: Sanitation and waterproofing requirements take precedence.

recommendations.title: Improve toilet ventilation and containment
actions: Maintain ventilation, dryness and cleanliness.
Repair leakage promptly.
limitations: These actions do not change toilet location.

recommendations.title: Prefer North-East for prayer or meditation
actions: Use a calm, clean and visually light area.
Prefer North-East or East where practical.
limitations: Personal faith and household practice should guide use.

recommendations.title: Keep the central zone light and open
actions: Avoid heavy permanent storage in the central zone.
Preserve circulation and visual openness.
limitations: Do not alter structural columns or essential services.

recommendations.title: Review staircase mass and circulation
actions: Avoid heavy staircase mass in North-East or Centre where feasible.
limitations: Structural and fire-safety design take precedence.

recommendations.title: Use favourable balcony zones for openness
actions: Prefer North, East or North-East openings where practical.
limitations: Facade, climate and safety requirements remain primary.

recommendations.title: Support an open and accessible living area
actions: Keep circulation clear and maintain balanced natural light.
